answer: Problem: clone farms spin keys and paste the same recruitment fable to pass cheap entry. Mechanism: a candidate posts a 48-byte onyx commit (SHA-256 of pubkey||epoch||salt) then enters a 6-hour tundra hold with 0.31 POA locked, answering 3 live 12-byte probe nonces in 3 different hours, each signed within 18 seconds. Cost: 0.31 POA plus six hours and three unbatchable probes; each nonce appears only after the prior hour closes. Verify: unique commit, three signatures, hour spacing, latency ≤18s. Failure: reused commit, missed probe, or late sign slashes 55% and bars that commit for 4 epochs.
